summary: Explored the depth/batch-size axis under the fixed 5-minute budget. Both deeper (DEPTH=10, 1.001883) and shallower (DEPTH=6, 1.045636) models were clearly worse than the baseline DEPTH=8, showing depth was already near-optimal. Halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2^19 to 2^18 (more, slightly noisier optimizer steps) gave the best result of the share: val_bpb 0.989057 vs baseline 0.997359. Further halving to 2^17 (0.999683), raising MATRIX_LR to 0.05 (0.991229), and shortening WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.35 (0.991483) on top of the 2^18 batch config all failed to improve further, indicating batch size was the single lever that mattered here and the rest of the schedule was already well-tuned. Next things worth trying: an intermediate batch size between 2^18 and 2^19 (e.g. 1.5x steps) to check if 2^18 is truly the local optimum, or revisiting WINDOW_PATTERN/embedding LR now that the batch size is fixed.
